name: Landhaus Paradies
beschreibung: Landhaus Paradies welcomes travelers to the serene mountain village of Spiss in the Tyrolean Oberland, Austria's highest municipality at approximately 1,650 meters altitude. Situated on a sunny panoramic slope near the Swiss border, the property provides peaceful seclusion far from everyday rush. Cozy alpine-style rooms and apartments feature private balconies commanding spectacular views of the Samnaun mountain range. Its immediate proximity to the duty-free Swiss resort of Samnaun provides swift access to the world-renowned Silvretta Arena with over 230 kilometers of ski slopes. In summer, the high-alpine setting is a tranquil dream for hikers and mountain bikers.
kurzbeschreibung: Peaceful alpine holiday retreat in Spiss in the Tyrolean Oberland perched near Samnaun and Ischgl.
